tool.name: pmotools convert_to_pmo
tool.description: Convert text, Excel, or microhaplotype tables into PMO-compatible JSON
tool.command: pmotools-python $convert_mode.subcommand --file '$convert_mode.input_file' --output '$output_json' @OVERWRITE@ #if $convert_mode.subcommand == "text_meta_to_json_meta": --delim '$convert_mode.delim' #if $convert_mode.index_col_name: --index_col_name '$convert_mode.index_col_name' #end if #elif $convert_mode.subcommand == "excel_meta_to_json_meta": #if $convert_mode.sheet: --sheet '$convert_mode.sheet' #end if #if $convert_mode.index_col_name: --index_col_name '$convert_mode.index_col_name' #end if #elif $convert_mode.subcommand == "microhaplotype_table_to_json_file": #if $convert_mode.bioinfo_name: --bioinfo_name '$convert_mode.bioinfo_name' #end if --library_sample_name_col '$convert_mode.library_sample_name_col' --target_name_col '$convert_mode.target_name_col' --seq_col '$convert_mode.seq_col' --reads_col '$convert_mode.reads_col' #if $convert_mode.additional_cols: --additional_cols '$convert_mode.additional_cols' #end if --delim '$convert_mode.delim' #elif $convert_mode.subcommand == "terra_amp_output_to_json": --gt_sheet '$convert_mode.gt_sheet' --asv_table_sheet '$convert_mode.asv_table_sheet' --asv_seqs_sheet '$convert_mode.asv_seqs_sheet' #end if

param.name: subcommand
param.label: Conversion mode
param.option: Convert Terra amplicon output to JSON

param.name: index_col_name
param.label: Index column name
param.help: If provided, output will be a dict with this column as index; otherwise a list

param.name: sheet
param.label: Sheet name
param.help: Name of the sheet to convert; if not provided, defaults to the first sheet

param.name: index_col_name
param.label: Index column name
param.help: If provided, output will be a dict with this column as index; otherwise a list

param.name: bioinfo_name
param.label: Bioinformatics name
param.help: Identifier of the bioinformatics processing run

param.name: additional_cols
param.label: Additional columns
param.help: Comma-separated additional column names to include (use col:newname for renaming)

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input Terra amplicon output Excel file
param.help: Excel file with gt, asv_table, and asv_seqs sheets

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Convert to PMO JSON**
Converts external file formats into PMO-compatible JSON:
- **Text metadata to JSON**: Converts a tab- or comma-delimited metadata table into JSON format. Optionally uses an index column to produce a dict instead of a list. - **Excel metadata to JSON**: Converts an Excel metadata sheet into JSON format. Optionally specifies a sheet name and index column. - **Microhaplotype table to JSON**: Converts a microhaplotype table (with columns for library sample name, target name, sequence, and reads) into a PMO-compatible JSON structure. - **Terra amplicon output to JSON**: Converts a Terra amplicon output Excel file (with gt, asv_table, and asv_seqs sheets) into a PMO-compatible JSON structure.
**Input**
- A text/CSV file or an Excel (.xlsx) file, depending on the conversion mode
**Output**
- A JSON file in PMO-compatible format
